scientific_integrity: The new claim is only the rank of the second Cartier iterate. The previously established a-number \(q^2/16\) and the Galois-line classification are explicitly acknowledged as prior work; finite checks are not presented as the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic two; q a power of two at least 8. No result for all higher Cartier iterates or full Ekedahl-Oort type. Exact bibliography search does not certify publication priority; a 2021 dissertation on Cartier ranks was identified but its full text was not inspected. Independent mathematical validation was not performed.
title: The second Cartier rank of the even maximal curve of second-largest genus
